# The Debian development packages of the platform libraries the workspace
# links (design §7.2: platform libraries through pkg-config, never vendored;
# #1300), one per line, each with the crate whose build script or `-sys`
# dependency finds it, under the names ubuntu-26.04 gives them, the image
# the jobs that build the workspace run on (#1724). An extension that
# links a new platform library adds its line here, and every ubuntu job
# that builds the workspace installs it through this directory's action.
# `#` starts a comment.
#
# Not listed, since the runner's C library carries them: libintl.h
# (ext/gettext), iconv (ext/iconv), libresolv (ext/standard). Not listed,
# since the crate builds it from source it vendors: libmbfl (ext/mbstring),
# libmagic (ext/fileinfo), lexbor (ext/lexbor), uriparser (ext/uri), timelib
# (ext/date), libbzip2 (ext/bz2, libbz2-rs-sys, pure Rust).
pkg-config            # every build script below
libonig-dev           # ext/mbstring: pkg-config oniguruma, >= 6.8
libcurl4-openssl-dev  # ext/curl: curl-sys, pkg-config libcurl
libssl-dev            # ext/openssl: openssl-sys, OpenSSL 3
libsqlite3-dev        # ext/pdo_sqlite, ext/sqlite3: libsqlite3-sys, >= 3.34.1
libpcre2-dev          # ext/pcre, ext/fileinfo: pcre2-sys, pkg-config libpcre2-8
zlib1g-dev            # ext/zlib, ext/mysqlnd, ext/zip: libz-sys
liblzma-dev           # ext/zip: pkg-config liblzma, >= 5.2
libzstd-dev           # ext/zip: pkg-config libzstd, >= 1.4
libgmp-dev            # ext/gmp: pkg-config gmp, >= 6.0
libsodium-dev         # ext/sodium: pkg-config libsodium, >= 1.0.18
libtidy-dev           # ext/tidy: pkg-config tidy, >= 5.8
libgd-dev             # ext/gd: pkg-config gdlib, >= 2.3
libxml2-dev           # ext/libxml, ext/xsl: pkg-config libxml-2.0, >= 2.9
libxslt1-dev          # ext/xsl: pkg-config libxslt >= 1.1, libexslt >= 0.8
libedit-dev           # ext/readline: pkg-config libedit
libffi-dev            # ext/ffi: pkg-config libffi, >= 3.3
libicu-dev            # ext/intl: pkg-config icu-uc, icu-i18n, icu-io; the distribution's ICU, at or above the floor ext/intl's build states
